subject: Physics
central_question: How do changing electric and magnetic fields sustain electromagnetic waves, and how are spectrum regions produced and used?

known_pitfalls.claim: Current through a capacitor gap is ordinary conduction current.
known_pitfalls.correction: It is displacement current associated with changing electric flux.

known_pitfalls.claim: E and B point along propagation.
known_pitfalls.correction: Both are transverse and perpendicular to each other.

known_pitfalls.claim: Spectrum regions have perfectly sharp boundaries.
known_pitfalls.correction: Their ranges overlap and classification is approximate.

recommended_example_progression: NCERT Example 8.1: field amplitudes and directions
ncert_end_of_chapter_exercises_reference: The end-of-chapter EXERCISES run from 8.1 to 8.9.
